detail.longDescription: I have been using Uber during my recent travels to different cities and every time that I run into an issue and need to contact support, Uber fails to handle my issue with appropriate care or customer service. My issues are rapidly closed without the customer support agent even attempting to understanding the problem or read my messages carefully. I have attempted to provide evidences in the form of screenshots or SMS payment confirmation messages which are not even acknowledged. I've had to open multiple support issues for the same problem without any adequate resolution. How has your experience with Uber support been lately?
